dish_en: Thai volcano pork ribs, Leng Saap
product_desc: raw cut pork ribs in a black retail tray, meaty and pale pink with clean white bone ends. Frame the meat and the bare tray rim only: the printed label and barcode sit outside the shot, and no text of any kind appears in frame
cook: a professional chef in their thirties, dark chef coat with sleeves rolled to the forearm, focused and precise
kitchen: a clean semi-professional kitchen with stainless surfaces and a gas wok range, warm directional light, a few Thai aromatics visible in small bowls
prep_subject: meaty pork rib sections about ten centimetres long resting in a colander, beside them stalks of lemongrass bruised flat and cut into lengths, thick coins of sliced ginger, whole spring onions bruised along their length, and washed coriander roots. A small bowl of coarse salt sits at the back. No sauce and no colour on the meat at this stage
prep_defines: the rib length and the bruised aromatics that go into the water with them
cook_vessel: a tall stockpot of simmering broth
cook_subject: the ribs partway through their simmer inside a tall stockpot, submerged in cloudy pale broth that moves at a slow lazy roll rather than a boil. Lemongrass lengths, ginger coins and spring onion turn slowly among them, the meat pale and swollen, steam sitting over the surface. The lid rests to one side and a low flame is visible under the pot
cook_negatives: deep frying, a wok of hot oil, dark caramelised crust, dry ribs, barbecue glaze, a hard rolling boil, thick gravy in the pot
hero_subject: the simmered ribs stacked upright into a tall cone on a dark platter, the meat pale and visibly shrunk back from the clean white bone ends, a bright red-orange Thai dressing running down the outside of the stack, fresh coriander and sliced red chilli scattered over the top, lime wedges at the base
hero_setting: a dark slate surface with a banana leaf underneath, dramatic warm side light
story: ribs and bruised aromatics lowered into a pot of cold water
an hour of slow simmering until the meat pulls back from the bone
stacked into a volcano and the raw dressing poured down over it
negatives_global: deep frying, a wok of hot oil, dark caramelised crust, barbecue glaze, dry roast ribs, thick brown gravy, restaurant kitchen, plastic packaging, sealed tray, product label, printed nutrition panel, barcode
first_heat: The water is still cold and clear around them, and the lemongrass and ginger lift and turn as the ribs settle to the bottom of the pot.
transform: the broth clouds from clear to milky, the meat swells and pales and visibly shrinks back from the bone ends until the clean white tips stand proud, and the surface settles from a first boil into a slow lazy roll under a skin of steam.
lift: A pair of long tongs enters from the left, closes on one rib and lifts it clear of the broth to the centre of frame. The meat sags away from the bone under its own weight and broth runs off it in a thin stream. Nothing about it is browned or crisp.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame with tongs and stand the simmered ribs up against each other one at a time, bone ends outward, building them into a tall cone at the centre of the platter, then withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right, takes the topmost rib of the stack and pulls it free, holding it steady at the centre of frame while dressing runs off the meat and the bone slides clean.
sound_01: A professional kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, a colander set down on a stainless counter. In the second shot, lemongrass being bruised flat against a board with a dull woody knock, and ginger coins sliding together. In the third shot, ribs going into water with a heavy dull splash, then the aromatics after them. No boiling yet, no sizzling at any point. No speech.
sound_02: A long low simmer throughout, water turning over slowly, with the soft roar of a gas flame beneath it. In the first shot, a heavy metal lid lifting free with a ring and a rush of escaping steam. In the second shot, the simmer alone. In the third shot, tongs closing on bone and broth running off in a thin stream. There is no sizzle and no oil in this clip. No speech.
sound_03: A kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, bones knocking together as the ribs are stood up against each other on a hard platter. In the second shot, dressing pouring in a steady stream and running down over the meat. In the third shot, one rib pulled free of the stack. No speech.
music: A tropical percussion bed: hand drums and bamboo blocks over a syncopated bass line, hot and driving without being frantic.

beats.c1s1: <Subject 1> draws the ribs and the bruised aromatics together across the counter in one movement.
beats.c1s2: Both hands of <Subject 1> gather the lemongrass, ginger, spring onion and coriander root into one pile and slide them to the near edge beside the ribs, so the aromatics and the meat sit together ready to go into the water at the same moment.
beats.c1s3: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the ribs, lower them into the cold water of the pot until they are submerged, follow them with the bruised lemongrass, ginger and spring onion, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty.
beats.c3s2: The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame with a small jug of raw Thai dressing, bright red-orange and flecked with chopped chilli, garlic and coriander, and pours it in one steady stream onto the peak of the stack so it runs down every side, then withdraws straight up out of frame. The dressing is never cooked and never goes near the heat.

clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at pot height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The stockpot of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over its low flame, which stays visible at the bottom of frame throughout, the lid seated on top with steam escaping steadily around its rim. The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame, takes the lid handle, lifts the lid clear of the pot in one continuous movement and carries it out of the top of frame, releasing a full wave of steam as it goes. Behind the steam the ribs are revealed under cloudy broth at a slow lazy roll, lemongrass and ginger turning among them. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
vessel_start: filled with cold clear water and not yet lit, nothing else in it
